feature_notes:
First installable Python alpha of CrabXL, built with PyO3 over the canonical Rust engine.

Provides supported openpyxl-compatible Workbook, Worksheet and Cell calls, scalar/date/ISO values, normal/shared/array/data-table formulas, sparse owned operations and guarded original-package edits. Unsupported functionality raises explicitly; no openpyxl runtime fallback is used.

CPython 3.11 through 3.15 (currently RC) is packaged for Linux x86_64/ARM64, Windows x86_64 and macOS Intel/Apple Silicon. The release requires all 25 wheel build/test combinations and the sdist install/test to pass. Python wheel users do not need Rust; source builds require Rust 1.99 or newer. Compilation uses the latest stable Rust toolchain.

The engine is pinned to post-alpha.1 core revision with the Windows same-path save fix d39d5e8f413a0f239075464906f984e6c66c8350. Compatibility is partial: full styles/rich-text Python objects, optimized modes, loaded structural editing and advanced features remain staged. See docs/roadmap.md for boundaries.
